name: dsfd_gth_re_transverse_1015

job.purpose: S81 gather v4 DIRECT leaf (E half) of the gather cluster dsfd_sp_gather_c: 4 roots ot_s81ph_ret_root_s (step B, S = 8 open rows = 2 x the measured real bound 4), queue 128 x 66 + pairing store 256 x 34 arrays per root; the leaf takes only its own 4 lanes and returns only its own 4 results + {busy, fault}; the parent delivers / collects through relay tiles in the channels (no lane or chain passes through a leaf).  Every port a flop at the pin.
job.structural_change: After g7/g8/g9/g10 failed routing across continuous 116um SRAM walls, separate each actual root bank pair by 20.304um transverse routing channels (49.248um pitch, pairing macro height28.944um); leaf height164.16->224.64. Preserves exact source, all494 signal ports and data pin centres, latency, clock period and constraints; N clock/reset follow new boundary. Parent height803.52->1045.44; MIX4 independently confirms PQ/PQROM +86.4um preserves17.28um/86.4um neighbor gaps inside reticle. This is candidate slot grant only, requires native pins/CTS/TT/FF/DRC and full graph adoption. Removes g10 clock-pair retap instead of layering an unproven workaround onto source.
